howItWorks.title: Three Steps to a Catalog

steps.title: Add Your Products

steps.title: Build Your Catalog

steps.title: Share with Customers

features.title: Why DijiCatalog?

items.title: Multi-Tenant Architecture
items.description: Each customer operates in their own data space. Tenant isolation enforced at middleware level — zero data leak risk.

items.title: PDF Generation

items.title: Image Management

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: What you want to know from day one.

items.question: What is DijiCatalog?
items.answer: A rentable digital catalog SaaS. Build your product library, prepare customer-specific catalogs, share them via public link or PDF.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: Depending on your setup choice: on your own server (on-premise MSSQL/PostgreSQL) or in the cloud (Railway, Azure). Your data is entirely yours, never shared with third parties.

items.question: How does Korgün ERP integration work?
items.answer: Stock and customer records are pulled directly from the Korgün ERP database. When new products or customers are added, sync runs in one click — no manual data entry.

items.question: How do I share a customer viewer?
items.answer: The share button on the catalog detail page generates a unique public link. Send it via WhatsApp, email, or QR code. Customers view it without signing in.

items.question: How is pricing structured?
items.answer: We are currently in early access. Signing up gives you full-feature access with a trial account. Custom pricing is available for enterprise usage.
